title: A new Cities: Skylines Series: Franklin
premise: Donoteat announces Franklin using escalating title cards that promise a Cities: Skylines series across time, education and entertainment, then reveal the series name, creator credit and June 23 arrival date. The grand claims are trailer hype, and no city story is narrated.
coverage: Black title cards build toward the Franklin name, creator credit and June 23 release announcement. The tiny possible “Thank you” is uncertain; no speaker is identified. The year is not printed.

panels.heading: Black opening
panels.description: The trailer opens on a black screen, with no city view, character or explanatory scene before the first title card.
panels.notes: The first title card follows after a moment of black.

panels.heading: Setup: unprecedented trailer claim
panels.description: Centered white capitals on black read 'FOR THE FIRST TIME ON YOUTUBE'. The novelty claim is pure promotion.
panels.camera: Fixed centered lettering that fades to black.
panels.action: The card holds, then darkens. No characters appear.
panels.visualGag: The mock-grand trailer starts with 'FOR THE FIRST TIME ON YOUTUBE', escalates to 'TRANSCEND THE BOUNDARIES OF TIME' and ends on 'SCREEN NEAR YOU'. Pitching a Cities: Skylines series in such sweeping language reads as playful hyperbole.
panels.notes: A faint “Thank you” may be audible under this card. The speaker is unknown, and the words have nothing to do with the printed text.

panels.heading: Escalation: boundaries of time
panels.description: White two-line capitals read 'A CITIES SKYLINES SERIES WILL / TRANSCEND THE BOUNDARIES OF TIME'. The grand promise is made entirely in text; no city history or time travel is shown.
panels.camera: Fixed two-line lettering that fades to black.
panels.action: The card holds and darkens, with no gameplay or characters.
panels.visualGag: A city-building series gets the sweeping promise 'TRANSCEND THE BOUNDARIES OF TIME', and the hyperbole keeps up the movie-trailer tone.
panels.notes: According to the video description, the series follows a city's development over time.

panels.heading: The educational and entertainment promise
panels.description: Centered white capitals read 'AND EDUCATE AND ENTERTAIN YOU / ALONG THE WAY'. This third plain text card states the series' purpose without showing any examples.
panels.camera: Fixed two-line card, followed by the logo.
panels.action: Static text card, with no characters or city building.
panels.visualGag: This card bridges the sequence, bringing the time-transcending promise back down to education and entertainment before the title and release date arrive. It has no punchline of its own.

panels.heading: Title reveal: Franklin
panels.description: A large orange FRANKLIN wordmark, with dark outlined, extruded-looking edges and a cracked bell emblem on its right, appears alone on black.
panels.action: The title holds on screen and the bell emblem stays still.
panels.visualGag: After all that buildup, the trailer reveals the name: Franklin. The bell is part of the logo rather than a separate joke.

panels.heading: Creator-credit layer
panels.description: The orange Franklin title remains. Beneath it, white text reads 'A DONOTEAT' and 'SERIES' on either side of a round, coin-like creator emblem with a reddish diagonal band.
panels.action: The title and credit hold still, round emblem included.
panels.visualGag: The staged name and creator credit keep the trailer buildup going toward the 'ARRIVING AT A SCREEN NEAR YOU' release date.
panels.notes: The tiny lettering on the round emblem is too small to read.

panels.heading: Payoff: arriving at a screen near you
panels.description: The completed card keeps the Franklin title and creator credit and adds 'ARRIVING AT A SCREEN NEAR YOU JUNE 23' across the lower portion, delivering the release date after all the escalating promises.
panels.camera: Fixed framing on the full announcement card.
panels.action: The finished card holds, with no characters or gameplay.
panels.visualGag: The payoff borrows the theatrical-release formula 'ARRIVING AT A SCREEN NEAR YOU' for an online Cities: Skylines series. The joke is printed on the card in movie-trailer language rather than spoken.
panels.notes: The card gives June 23 without a year.

panels.heading: Exit: lingering emblem, then black
panels.description: The title and surrounding text vanish, leaving only the round creator emblem where the credit line was. Then the screen goes black, and the trailer ends without another scene.
panels.camera: Fixed framing while the text and title disappear, then the emblem, ending on black.
panels.action: The title, credit and date text disappear first, followed by the emblem. Nothing moves.
panels.notes: The panel image is the final black screen; the emblem-only moment just before it is brief.
